subject: PubliGate onboarding: request for subprocessor roster, data flow and KMS evidence
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@publigate.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@publigate.com
Date: 2026-01-13T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick ask: subprocessor roster + dataflow for PubliGate tenant onboarding

Hi Irene,

We're progressing with the PubliGate integration (thanks for the quick demo last week). Our security team has a short set of asks to close the vendor review:

- Full list of subprocessors that may process tenant data for the PubliGate integration (including any CDN, telemetry, or metrics processors).
- A simple data flow diagram showing where tenant PII/metadata traverses (regions / egress paths).
- Any attestation/evidence about key management (KMS/HSM) used for customer data at rest and in transit.

Can you share the roster and a timeline for evidence delivery? We're aiming to finalize this side by EOD Friday.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Security Program Manager
PubliGate

To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@publigate.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-01-13T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: subprocessor roster + dataflow for PubliGate tenant onboarding

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. High level response and next steps below.

What we can provide now (attached):
- processor_roster_20260113.csv (contains vendor name, role, country, export jurisdictions)
- dataflow_publigate_v1.drawio (simple diagram with routing and country boundaries)
- kms_attestation_summary.pdf (summary of KMS provider, a note on HSM usage where applicable, and encryption-in-transit controls)

Outstanding items:
- Full HSM key ceremony logs and vendor contracts: legal needs additional time and will follow up (we expect a draft package by close of day Thursday).
- PCI/Pseudonymization granular mappings — if PubliGate requires tokenization specifics we can add a prompt engineering mapping doc (need to confirm scope).

CC'ing Kimberly (Security) for any technical clarifications and Jonas (Legal) for contract/attestation schedule.

Timeline proposal:
- Today: roster + dataflow + attestation summary (attached)
- Thu COB: legal evidence packet (contracts, redacted SLAs)
- Fri: final Q/A or a short call if needed

If that works, we'll flag any processors that require temporary exceptions for the pilot and include mitigation notes.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: processor_roster_20260113.csv, dataflow_publigate_v1.drawio, kms_attestation_summary.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@publigate.com>, irene_choi@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-01-13T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: subprocessor roster + dataflow for PubliGate tenant onboarding

Alex / Irene — quick technical clarifications from Security:

1) The roster contains a couple of transient telemetry processors used for burst diagnostics (listed as on-call vendors). For the pilot, we can scope them out of any PII path and enable prefix/KV caching to avoid tokenization leakage — see roster notes column.
2) Our KMS architecture: Primary keys are in AWS KMS (multi-region replication disabled by default). For the highest-sensitivity tenants we offer a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) flow; HSM-backed keys are used for signing and key-wrapping in those cases. The kms_attestation_summary.pdf has the architecture diagram.
3) Cross-border note: any telemetry egress to third parties is routed through our US gateway (us-east-1) unless the customer requests EU residency.

If PubliGate needs the full key ceremony artifacts, Jonas can propose a redaction pattern for contract attachments (PI/secret removal) — Jonas?

Irene: marking this as urgent for legal follow-up.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@publigate.com>, kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, irene_choi@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-01-13T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: subprocessor roster + dataflow for PubliGate tenant onboarding

Hi Alex — thanks for the patience. Quick legal note:

- We'll produce a redacted contract bundle (DocuSign-ready) containing the relevant subprocessor clauses and the KMS provider agreement excerpt. Redactions will remove any third-party commercial rates and internal contact details. Expect that package by Thu COB, as Irene suggested.
- For formal attestations requested by your auditors, we can provide a signed letter with scope limited to the PubliGate integration and referencing the attached kms_attestation_summary.pdf.
- If you need us to sign an additional NDA or an auditor-specific questionnaire (e.g., SIG Lite), send the form and we'll triage.

Next step: Alex, can you confirm whether PubliGate requires EU-only residency for this tenant (that would change routing and some processors)? If not, we'll proceed with the US gateway defaults above.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
